description: The saved versions of a report that the person may read, newest first, without their content: each version's number, when it was saved, who saved it, and a fingerprint of its content (two versions with the same fingerprint have the same content). The answer also gives the report's newest version number, which restore_report_version needs. Long histories come a page at a time: send nextBefore from the answer as before to read the next page.

before.description: Only versions numbered below this: the nextBefore of the previous page. Leave it out for the newest page.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: list_report_versions
title: A report's versions
